name: Conntour
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
long_description:
Conntour enables government agencies to query their video - from security cameras, body cams, and drones.

Users can search past footage (“Find a man with tattoos on his left arm”), configure real-time alerts (“Notify me if someone climbs over the wall”), and extract data (“How many pickup trucks entered yesterday?”).

Unlike traditional video analytics solutions, which are limited to fixed parameters (like a weapon, bag, or car color), Conntour supports an unlimited range of highly specific scenarios described in plain language. This enables a single human to monitor thousands of cameras, or find a specific moment in minutes instead of days.

What makes Conntour's technology unique is its ability to process video using natural language at scale, fully on-premises, with minimal hardware requirements. The system is already deployed with mission-critical teams at leading intelligence and homeland security agencies.

Conntour is backed by top-tier investors including General Catalyst and Y Combinator, was selected for the first-ever Palantir Fellowship, and has the former CTO of the CIA on its advisory board.
